artist.name: CHHABB
artist.bio: Chhabb is Rahul Chhabria, a DJ and producer born and raised in Mumbai and a key name in India's experimental electronic scene. He has played with The Bunker New York and Giegling, and appears on Padmini Records' compilation Yaar-Dost vol. 2.

eras.sound: Deep house, acid and techno for the floor
